title: Pure Floowandereeze
summary: Floowandereeze cards only, with generic staples. Floowandereeze is a Normal Summon deck: the Level 1 birds give up Special Summoning for the turn and chain extra Normal Summons into a big Tribute Summon. Floowandereeze & Robina searches a small Winged Beast, Eglen searches a Level 7 or higher one, Toccan recovers a banished Floowandereeze, and Stri banishes a card from either GY. Each of them grants another Normal Summon right away. Floowandereeze and the Magnificent Map Normal Summons a bird from the hand every turn, and again when the opponent Normal Summons. Floowandereeze & Empen searches a Floowandereeze Spell/Trap when Tribute Summoned and stops their Attack Position Special Summons from activating. Floowandereeze & Snowl grants three Normal Summons and flips their Special Summoned monsters face-down. Floowandereeze and the Scary Sea negates a Special Summon. The Extra Deck is the generic Link package; the deck rarely Special Summons.
